name: New York Multimate PBQ V 2026
information:
This competition only has blind events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in New York](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=New+York&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS COMPETITON HAS SEPARATE REGISTRATION LIMITS FOR EACH EVENT. Please refer to tab titled "Separate Event Registration Limits" for more details. Registrations for each event will be accepted on a first come, first served basis, and a per event waiting list will be managed manually, and will be listed in the Separate Event Registration Limit tab once registration is open.
